description: This file contains unit tests for the Reflect utility class in the OpenMRS project, focusing on reflection-based field and class inspection in the context of OpenMRS model classes.

classes.name: ReflectTest
classes.description: Contains JUnit 5 test cases for the Reflect utility class, testing reflection features such as field discovery, class hierarchy, collection recognition, and generic type inspection.

classes.name: NormalClass
classes.description: Helper class with a single string field to test reflection methods.

classes.name: OpenmrsObjectImp
classes.description: Test implementation of OpenmrsObject, extending NormalClass, with additional fields for reflection tests.

methods.name: xhasField_shouldReturnTrueIfGivenFieldIsDeclaredInParameterizedClassOrSubClass
methods.description: Tests that Reflect.hasField returns true for fields declared in subclasses or with generic types.

methods.name: xhasField_shouldReturnFalseIfGivenFieldIsNotDeclaredInParameterizedClassOrItsSubClass
methods.description: Tests that Reflect.hasField returns false for fields not declared in the class or its subclasses.

methods.name: getAllFields_shouldReturnAllFieldsIncludePrivateAndSuperClasses
methods.description: Confirms that Reflect.getAllFields includes all declared fields from class hierarchy.

methods.name: isCollection_shouldReturnFalseIfGivenFieldClassIsNotACollectionClass
methods.description: Verifies that non-collection classes are correctly identified as not collections.

methods.name: isCollection_shouldReturnTrueIfGivenFieldClassIsCollectionClass
methods.description: Verifies that Collection classes are correctly identified.

methods.name: isCollection_shouldReturnFalseIfGivenObjectIsNotACollection
methods.description: Checks that non-Collection objects are not mistakenly identified as collections.

methods.name: isCollection_shouldReturnTrueIfGivenObjectIsCollectionClass
methods.description: Checks that Collection objects are recognized as collections.

methods.name: Reflect_shouldThrowExceptionWhenNullIsPassed
methods.description: Ensures that Reflect constructor throws NullPointerException when null class is supplied.

methods.name: getInheritedFields_shouldReturnOnlyTheSubClassFieldsOfGivenParameterizedClass
methods.description: Verifies that getInheritedFields returns only fields declared in subclasses, not in parent classes.

methods.name: isCollectionField_shouldReturnTrueIfGivenFieldIsCollectionAndItsElementTypeIsGivenParameterized
methods.description: Tests that a field with a parameterized collection element type is correctly recognized.

methods.name: isCollectionField_shouldReturnFalseIfGivenFieldIsNotACollection
methods.description: Verifies that non-collection fields are not falsely identified as collections.

methods.name: isCollectionField_shouldReturnFalseIfGivenFieldIsCollectionAndElementTypeIsOtherThanGiven
methods.description: Ensures that fields with collection types but mismatched element types are not recognized as matching.

methods.name: isSuperClass_shouldReturnFalseIfGivenSubClassIsNotAccessibleFromGivenParameterizedClass
methods.description: Tests that isSuperClass returns false when class hierarchy does not match.

methods.name: isSuperClass_shouldReturnTrueIfGivenSubClassIsAccessibleFromGivenParameterizedClass
methods.description: Tests true behavior when subclass is subclass of the class.

methods.name: isSuperClass_shouldReturnFalseIfGivenObjectIsNotAccessibleFromGivenParameterizedClass
methods.description: Verifies that isSuperClass returns false for incompatible object instances.

methods.name: isSuperClass_shouldReturnTrueIfGivenObjectIsAccessibleFromGivenParameterizedClass
methods.description: Verifies true for compatible object instances.

methods.name: isSuperClass_shouldReturnTrueForAGenericWhoseBoundIsASubclass
methods.description: Tests isSuperClass with generic type parameter whose bound is a subclass.

methods.name: isSuperClass_shouldReturnFalseForAGenericWhoseBoundIsNotASubclass
methods.description: Tests isSuperClass with generic type parameter whose bound is not a subclass.
